idk how we keep running into problems with loopcut but i somehow am getting 3 cuts when calling for 2, look here [Image #1] there is already 2 cuts done. il add 2 more the other direction [Image #2] you can see before i confirm the cut that i already am blind to where the other cuts are but i see the blue line for one of them
[Image #3] and now i came out with 3 cuts. [Image #4]
resolution: The apparent third loop cut was the wall starter's pre-existing internal seam: two half-depth render boxes had been merged verbatim into editable topology. Restored the structural/render boundary so paired wall halves coalesce before model creation. Added a native regression for two cuts followed by two perpendicular cuts; the compiled-host replay ends at exactly 30 quads with two loop-cut history entries and valid ownership.
